derivedFrom: Thông tư 105/2020/TT-BTC Điều 5 and Phụ lục 1, read from the official VBQPPL portal at moj.gov.vn; Quyết định 124/2004/QĐ-TTg for the 63 province codes, cross-checked against chinhphu.gov.vn, thuvienphapluat.vn and vietnamnet.vn; Published mobile prefix ranges for Viettel, Vinaphone, Mobifone, Vietnamobile and Gmobile; Nghị định 137/2015 and Thông tư 07/2016/TT-BCA for the card number structure
description: Vietnamese identity numbers, pinned as a contract between two ports. A tax code has a check digit and can be verified. A card number has none, so "valid" here means well-formed with a province code that exists, and the suite says so rather than implying more.

tables.mstSource: Thông tư 105/2020/TT-BTC Điều 5 and Phụ lục 1, read from the official VBQPPL portal at moj.gov.vn
tables.mstCheckDigitOfZeroRemainder: null -- Thông tư 105/2020/TT-BTC skips the sequence number when the weighted sum divides exactly by 11, because 10 - 0 is 10 and is not a digit
tables.provinceCodeRange: 001 to 096, with gaps that are not assignments
tables.note: thẻ Căn cước (from 2024) and thẻ CCCD gắn chip have the same 12-digit structure, and the 2025 reduction to 34 provincial units did not renumber any card. Nothing in this suite can tell the generations apart.
